mode_contract.not_capture_guarantee: PreferCapture is an original Graph preference, not a guarantee of full capture or no re-recording.

actual_check.compile_flags: Retained current Model recipe /W4 /WX /O2 /MD with /c replaced by /Zs; same CPU+CUDA capability macros and cached external include paths.
